# Balance report

Generated by `npm run balance -- --seeds 30 --warps 10` at commit `93eb577`. The bot (`scripts/bot.ts`) plays the flagship; drones and haulers use their built-in AI. Hazards: normal. Times are sim time (m:ss). Cells show median (min–max) across seeds.

## Opening (system 1)

Every warp starts a fresh run (new fleet, new loadout), so the opening asks what the player should have built before leaving system 1, not what a long stay would reach. A target passes when at least 80% of seeds reach it before the first warp. The bot warps as soon as the bank holds the fuel, so it is the impatient player.

## Active-play share (#46)

Active-play share is `(flagship unloads + contract rewards) / all income`, all income being flagship + drones + haulers + contracts. Contract rewards count as active play because the player earns them by mining, breaking and delivering; haulers (miner skims and outpost output, #39) count as idle play alongside drones. Target: **≥ 40% through the mid-game** (systems 3–6).

- Mid-game pooled (income-weighted, 120 seed-warps): **60%** (flagship 45% · drones 34% · haulers 5% · contracts 15%) — **PASS**
- Mid-game across seed-warps: median 61%, 48%–83%
- Per system (median, min–max): 3: 62% (51%–83%) · 4: 63% (48%–76%) · 5: 59% (52%–77%) · 6: 59% (51%–72%)
